title: Engineering
description: A lightweight engineering modpack focused on automation, programmable systems, and steam-powered machines powered by Create and CC:Tweaked.
body:
⚙️ Engineering the Skies

Design factories, automate production, program custom computer systems, and take to the skies with steam-powered aircraft. Built around Create, Create Aeronautics, and CC:Tweaked, this lightweight engineering modpack focuses on creativity, automation, and mechanical innovation without unnecessary bloat.
